title: AI Won't Make You Rich Overnight. But It Can Do This.
style: Read this like a funny, honest, energetic friend in a quick social video. Playful on the joke, then clear and practical.

segments.title: "Make $10K a month with AI while you sleep"
segments.say: Everyone online says AI will make you ten thousand dollars a month while you sleep. Let's be real. It won't. But here are three honest ways people actually earn extra money with it.

segments.title: Where AI actually helps you earn
bullets: 1. Sell a service to local businesses
3. Sell simple templates from your own know-how
segments.say: One: sell a simple service to local businesses, like social posts or review replies. Two: if you freelance, use AI to finish the first draft faster, so you can take more jobs. Three: turn what you already know into simple templates or checklists people can buy. In every case, AI is the helper. Your skill and your review are what people pay for.

segments.title: Follow for more real AI money tips
bullets: Results vary. It still takes real work
segments.say: Which one would you try first? Tell me in the comments. Follow Run It With AI for more real, no-hype tips.
